say:1:1121101001:1.text: Magister, here's a letter from Dolly! It's got our names on it!
say:1:1121101001:1.source_cn: 主人，这里有一封给我们的信，是多莉小姐寄来的！上面还写...
say:1:1121101001:1.male: Magister, here's a letter from Dolly! It's got our names on it!
say:1:1121101001:1.female: Magister, here's a letter from Dolly! It's got our names on it!

say:2:1121101002:2.text: Hmm, I wonder why Dolly suddenly sent us this letter.
say:2:1121101002:2.source_cn: 咦，多莉小姐怎么会突然寄信来？
say:2:1121101002:2.male: Hmm, I wonder why Dolly suddenly sent us this letter.
say:2:1121101002:2.female: Hmm, I wonder why Dolly suddenly sent us this letter.

say:4:1121101003:1.text: "Dear Magister Merlin, Chippy, and Hammie, it's been a while. I hope everything is going well with your journey."
say:4:1121101003:1.source_cn: “梅林大人，还有可爱的满满和漫漫，好久不见了。希望你们...
say:4:1121101003:1.male: "Dear Magister Merlin, Chippy, and Hammie, it's been a while. I hope everything is going well with your journey."
say:4:1121101003:1.female: "Dear Magister Merlin, Chippy, and Hammie, it's been a while. I hope everything is going well with your journey."

say:5:1121101004:1.text: "Recently, there've been some strange occurrences at the Mystical House. It's hard to explain in a letter."
say:5:1121101004:1.source_cn: “最近，神秘屋发生了一些奇怪的状况，在信里很难详述。”
say:5:1121101004:1.male: "Recently, there've been some strange occurrences at the Mystical House. It's hard to explain in a letter."
say:5:1121101004:1.female: "Recently, there've been some strange occurrences at the Mystical House. It's hard to explain in a letter."

say:6:1121101005:1.text: "If you've got a moment to spare, could you come back so we can talk in person? Love, Dolly"
say:6:1121101005:1.source_cn: “如果有空的话，能否回来当面谈谈呢？——爱你们的，多莉”
say:6:1121101005:1.male: "If you've got a moment to spare, could you come back so we can talk in person? Love, Dolly"
say:6:1121101005:1.female: "If you've got a moment to spare, could you come back so we can talk in person? Love, Dolly"

say:9:1121101006:1.text: Dolly is usually able to handle all sorts of situations. If she's reaching out to us, it's probably about something that left her stumped...
say:9:1121101006:1.source_cn: 多莉小姐很擅长处理突发状况，可能是遇到了她也束手无策的...
say:9:1121101006:1.male: Dolly is usually able to handle all sorts of situations. If she's reaching out to us, it's probably about something that left her stumped...
say:9:1121101006:1.female: Dolly is usually able to handle all sorts of situations. If she's reaching out to us, it's probably about something that left her stumped...

say:10:1121101007:2.source_cn: 事不宜迟，那我们早点出发吧，主人！

say:11:1121101008:0.text: Chippy's been dreaming about the tea that Dolly always brews.
say:11:1121101008:0.source_cn: 正好满满也想念多莉小姐亲手煮的红茶了！

narration:12:1121101009:0.text: You return to the Mystical House...
